`verified_oval.json` is an original automatically connected four-piece creator
circuit with a placed start line. The replay contains only 12,757 quantized
120 Hz input triples generated by the existing diagnostic `RouteDriver` and
unchanged canonical simulation. Five complete ordered-gate laps finish at
106,308 ms (interpolated finish), with integer lap tick counts
`2634, 2532, 2531, 2530, 2530`.

Generated on Windows x86_64 using the exact `godot-version.txt` engine and
`res://backend/generate_fixture.gd`, through the same three-metre standing-start
setup used by the verifier. This is regression data, never a production run or
leaderboard submission. Linux container verification must run this fixture
before accepting deployment; float equivalence across platforms is not assumed.
